rationale: The NASA formalization describes a black-box advanced controller, timed monitor, safe-start/carry-over condition, recoverable-state premise and reversionary controller leading to a safe state. It supports a conditional formal safety property, exactly as the claim says, rather than an unconditional implementation result.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-005-R1 — PDF pp. 5–8, Simplex architecture and Plaidypvs rule
S-EVID-005-R2 — PDF pp. 8–12, RTA premises and productive-conflict-avoidance example
limitations: This is a NASA research formalization, not civil approval or implementation evidence.
The guarantee depends on monitor observability and timing, dynamics, switching and recovery-controller premises; it does not show a perception miss is observable early enough.
